title: content-gap insight export as CSV for editorial workflow
summary: Export ranked content gaps as CSV for editorial planning.
usage: WordPress admin → AI Chat for Amazon Bedrock → Conversations → Content gaps → Download content gaps CSV.
limitations: Administrator access is required. Includes up to 15 ranked groups from the last 30 days of retained exchanges; list filters do not apply. Counts cover gap-contributing exchanges, not all answers. An empty report contains only the header. The CSV contains visitor questions.
upgrade: Update to 1.47.0 using the WordPress plugin updater or the release ZIP. Back up the site before upgrading; retain the previous plugin package and backup for rollback. Logging and retention settings continue to apply.
